Pro Log: NSN’s 2027 kit includes Finlay Tarling tribute; AlUla ends Jayco sponsorship and pro race; TotalEnergies to sponsor Vollering’s FDJ United

The past week’s pro cycling news highlights, including the first new kit to drop for the 2027 season

NSN Cycling Team
byRobyn Davidson
Published: 23 November 2026 | Last updated: 23 November 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:51
Instaread

Welcome back to another edition of Pro Log, here’s a rundown of the latest cyclocross results before we get started:

  • Men’s Beringen, X²O Badkamers Trophy, Sun 22nd November: 1st Thibau Nys, Baloise Verzekeringen – Het Poetsbureau Lions, 1h 00min 47sec; 2nd Witse Meeussen, Crelan – Corendon, +00sec; 3rd Michael Vanthourenhout, Pauwels Sauzen – Altez Industriebouw, +03sec.
  • Women’s Beringen, X²O Badkamers Trophy, Sun 22nd November: 1st Sara Casasola, Crelan – Corendon, 52min 19sec; 2nd Lucinda Brand, Baloise Verzekeringen – Het Poetsbureau Lions, +24sec; 3rd Aniek van Alphen, 777TV CX Team, +1min 42sec.
  • Men’s Lokeren, HG Cross, Sat 21st November: 1st Gerben Kuypers, Pauwels Sauzen – Altez Industriebouw, 1hr 00min 11sec; 2nd Joran Wyseure, Crelan – Corendon, +02sec; 3rd Cameron Mason, 777TV CX Team, +03sec.
  • Women’s Lokeren, HG Cross, Sat 21st November: 1st Sara Casasola, Crelan – Corendon, 46min 54sec; 2nd Lucinda Brand, Baloise Verzekeringen – Het Poetsbureau Lions, +41sec; 3rd Ceylin del Carmen Alvarado, Fenix Premier-Tech, +1min 07sec.

NSN Cycling reveal 2027 kit

NSN Cycling’s 2027 kit will be similar to this season’s but with a lot more orange and tribute to the late Finlay Tarling.

The words on the rear of the jersey read ‘#ForFin’, honouring the young Welshman who died at a race in August this year.

The team said in the announcement, ‘We’ll carry Fin on our backs next year, knowing he’ll always have ours.’

Primož Roglič signs for NSN

In more NSN news, Primož Roglič has joined the team on a one-year contract. The 37-year-old batted away rumours of retirement on his departure from Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe, and after a several teams were linked with the four-time Vuelta winner, it has now been revealed he’ll ride for NSN, with eyes on Tour de France leadership.

He’ll join a host of newly acquired climbing talent on the Swiss-Catalan team including former Giro winner Richard Carapaz, two-time Giro stage winner Santiago Buitrago and former UAE Tour winner Lennert Van Eetvelt.

AlUla withdraws cycling investments

After several seasons of increased Middle Eastern investment in cycling, last week saw a significant step away, with Saudi Arabia's AlUla region withdrawing its sponsorship of the Jayco-AlUla teams and cancelling the early-season AlUla Tour race.

The AlUla Tour had been upgraded from 2.1 to 2.Pro status in 2026, however the Saudi Cycling Federation did not register it with the UCI for 2027.

Similarly, the revival of the Tour of Qatar, last raced in 2016, has been postponed to 2028.

TotalEnergies end men's sponsorships to join FDJ United women's team

FDJ United-Suez will get a new title sponsor in 2028 with the arrival of French energy giant TotalEnergies, which is ending its sponsorships of both the TotalEnergies men's ProTeam – which will become XEFI – and Netcompany Ineos.

The five-year deal will see Demi Vollering's squad become TotalEnergies-FDJ United from 2027.
